registration.name: TUKABEL · Nika · Pisklavý zpěvavý hlas
registration.description: Native Slovak, crisp Slovak diction. An adult woman in her thirties, a wildly theatrical comic stage diva with a piercing bright soprano. Strong mature vocal projection, metallic whistle-like upper resonance and very precise consonants. Ridiculously elastic melodic rises and drops, smug playful emphasis, clipped decisive punchlines, then a sly drawn-out vowel. An exaggerated and slightly unnerving adult cartoon soprano, never a soft narrator. Her confident adult personality and bold acting dominate every line. Clearly intelligible speech at a moderate pace, not sustained singing. Dry close studio recording without music, echo, ambience or effects.
